state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has emerged as a prominent destination for frontier technology investments, highlighted by major data center projects from Google and Reliance in Visakhapatnam [R1349768b, R37f1fbdf]. The state government is advancing workforce readiness through large-scale skilling initiatives in partnership with companies like IBM and programs under FutureSkills PRIME [Rb7d37144, R9fe15d9b], alongside plans to establish India's first quantum and AI university campus in Amaravati [R2d894836, R278c90f7]. Furthermore, administrative operations and public services are integrating artificial intelligence across sectors such as tax enforcement, healthcare, policing, and school education [R6e71a6d9, R37bbf64f, R3a304a95, Re98842fe].

state:Bihar.text: The Government of Bihar has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through strategic investments, policy rollouts, and multi-sector integration. Major developments include multi-crore Memorandums of Understanding signed at the India AI Impact Summit and a substantial investment by CtrlS for an AI data centre [R44971ae6, Rd3f465ac]. The state has actively incorporated AI across education, healthcare, governance, and infrastructure, establishing partnerships with firms like Google and Microsoft to train teachers and students [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306]. Additionally, administrative frameworks like the paperless e-Cabinet system, AI-driven surveillance, and public service delivery enhancements reflect the state's broader digital transformation [Re986d143, R1c32aa92, Rac954476].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has heavily promoted artificial intelligence across infrastructure, governance, and education through major policy frameworks and targeted partnerships [R3520c252, Re041bd74, Ra6932da2]. The state introduced a Data Centre Policy 2026-29 aiming for significant green AI capacity, alongside new GPU-as-a-Service frameworks and massive investments like a proposed ₹25,000 crore AI data centre in Dholera [Reff5d158, Rd1b68bba, R43f4ae2b]. Public administration initiatives have incorporated AI into police surveillance, agriculture quality testing, and public welfare schemes, while educational programs target training for hundreds of thousands of students [Ra310e3fc, R88fee491, R051380c0]. Meanwhile, the judiciary and legal sectors have experienced challenges, including the Gujarat High Court prohibiting AI use in judicial decision-making and addressing cases involving erroneous AI-generated citations [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: The Karnataka government has advanced several initiatives focused on artificial intelligence across governance, education, and infrastructure [Re78dfed2, Rfb9bafe5]. Key actions include planning early tech and AI training starting from Class 6 in government schools, launching affordable AI-ready computers named KEO for educational institutions, and establishing AI Centres of Excellence [R8176ca19, Rd2e6b41c, Ra4c0792f]. Additionally, the state has pursued major infrastructure projects like a proposed AI university and township, alongside partnerships with global firms to integrate AI into citizen services, agriculture, and public sector operations [Rc16dddf8, Rff273deb, R3e3399e8, R9082b90f].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through a cabinet-approved AI policy backed by a ₹10,000 crore investment plan and the creation of a dedicated Department of Electronics, IT, and AI [R562864e1, Rbff13ca0]. The state has launched large-scale infrastructure and regional innovation projects, including the $11 billion Tata AI Innovation City near Navi Mumbai and massive green data centre agreements [Rf8ceda95, Re0b416d1]. In governance and public services, the administration has deployed sovereign AI administrative tools like Sarvam AI for government users, established AI-driven portals for food safety and tourism, and integrated artificial intelligence into police investigations and public health [R68fee1a0, R04592b70, R57ef90d2, Rb96d46bb]. Furthermore, Maharashtra has pursued education and workforce transformations by mandating AI training for school teachers and partnering on digital skills programs with technology leaders [R2889d124, R481bc633].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major industrial investments and infrastructure projects, including partnerships with Sarvam AI for sovereign compute grids and multi-billion-rupee data centre deals with firms like HCLTech and Adani [Rdf1e1271, R31b27cb7, R3a36bb44, Re0acbc4f]. The state has also integrated AI into public administration and citizen services by deploying WhatsApp chatbots like 'Ama Sathi' for revenue and police services, launching automated E-Challan highway systems, and adopting AI surveillance for security and wildlife protection [R478c8c67, R19f1eab3, R8a2dd09f, R499f4234]. Furthermore, Odisha is reforming its education sector by incorporating AI courses into undergraduate, postgraduate, and apprenticeship curricula while establishing specialized tech and robotics labs statewide [Rdb5da3c5, R47f5da8c, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has advanced artificial intelligence initiatives across education, agriculture, governance, and law enforcement. The state integrated AI into the school curriculum through the Punjab School Education Board, introducing AI labs, hackathons, and career guidance programs [Rf6319e99, R18b7190d, Rc24de481, Rf4a0d422]. In agriculture and healthcare, collaborations with institutions like IIT Ropar introduced AI-driven weather stations, crop advisories, and screening devices for early cancer detection [R609b6fc5, R85a67327, R1f445527, R8d148d24]. Furthermore, law enforcement agencies adopted AI-powered voice recognition, automated traffic cameras, and smart command systems to tackle organized crime and improve public safety [R7333c0ad, Re289fcd5, Rfc758e25].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has aggressively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy initiatives, infrastructural investments, and public service transformations outlined in its budget and technology roadmaps [Rd8653bb5, R4dfec317]. Key structural developments include plans for a massive 1,000-acre AI city, a partnership with Sarvam AI to establish a Rs 10,000 crore Sovereign AI Park, and the creation of dedicated AI centers of excellence alongside a state-owned GPU cluster [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, R8b2c535d]. The state is also heavily integrating AI into governance and public welfare through WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for streamlined citizen services and healthcare access, alongside wildlife monitoring systems to prevent train-elephant collisions [R576baa19, R494484b4, R9a69237a]. Furthermore, educational reforms span from introducing AI curricula and training school teachers to launching specialized ITI trades and developing a regional Tamil Large Language Model [Rfe24cede, R5742a9b1, R528f13c2].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has pursued extensive AI-driven initiatives across governance, public services, and infrastructure, marked by the launch of the Telangana AI Innovation Hub and major data center investments [Rd6f74125, R5b4a7a80]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence into law enforcement, taxation, traffic management, and agricultural market monitoring to improve administrative efficiency [Ra1409382, R849548ed, Rce4536fa, R45e372bd]. Additionally, numerous partnerships have been established with technology firms and academic institutions to drive large-scale AI skill development and literacy programs for students and government employees [R998e03d5, R3bfd0d73, R59295049].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure projects, including plans for an AI City in Lucknow, a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida, and multi-billion-dollar data center investments [Rb3e432b8, Rb1cbd4df, Rad45bc42]. The state cabinet approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside a data center policy to support infrastructure, startups, and extensive youth skilling initiatives [Rb312992b, R398131aa]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI into public administration, utilizing tools for exam surveillance, criminal tracking, judicial transcription, and welfare scheme monitoring [Re0c4ff32, R231ba3cf, Ra6233201, Redec7e8e].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India are actively formulating comprehensive AI policies, mission frameworks, and major infrastructure investments to drive technological growth. Several states have approved specific funding and policy blueprints, such as Maharashtra's ₹10,000 crore AI policy allocation, Uttar Pradesh's AI mission focusing on startups and skilling, and Chhattisgarh's ₹500 crore AI mission [R562864e1, Rb312992b, R7cc53f61]. At the same time, regional authorities are prioritizing specialized hubs, data center policies, and dedicated tech cities in places like Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh [R1b6cbab3, Rb322fa47, R398131aa]. Beyond infrastructure, state administrations are integrating artificial intelligence into public service delivery, education curricula, governance, and administrative oversight [R8f4114ad, 2c0df2e5, R5c2eec42].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and judiciaries have actively pursued regulatory frameworks and ethical guidelines to manage the adoption of artificial intelligence. Multiple high courts, including those in Gujarat, Punjab, and Haryana, have prohibited or restricted the use of AI tools in judicial decision-making, judgment drafting, and legal research [Rbd9766bd, R8eacd504]. Concurrently, administrative bodies are establishing committees and protocols to address data privacy, governance, and misuse, such as Telangana's restrictions on uploading confidential taxpayer data to unauthorized AI platforms [R607d069a, Ra75d01a2] and Karnataka's ethical AI committee formation [R9b3c768e]. States are also addressing societal risks like deepfakes and cyber safety through specialized protocols, advisories, and proposed digital safety rules [Raf4f7b8d, Rc7b7e0d9, R7c216cfc].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments across India are committing substantial financial resources to build AI infrastructure, data centres, and specialized missions through major budgetary allocations and investment pacts [R44971ae6, R63bfb6f9]. Notable initiatives include Chhattisgarh's Rs 500 crore allocation for its AI Mission and large-scale private investments in data centres across states like Odisha, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh [R7cc53f61, R3eefbde9, R3a36bb44]. States are also dedicating funds to public sector AI integration, agriculture policies, higher education infrastructure, and workforce skill development schemes [R68fee1a0, Radc0ac36, Rb20c0b99, R297b1b1d].

category:infrastructure.text: State governments across India are significantly scaling up their AI infrastructure through major investments in data centres, AI cities, and specialized tech parks [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, Rb1cbd4df]. Prominent initiatives include multi-gigawatt data centre campuses, sovereign AI parks, and compute hubs launched through high-value Memorandums of Understanding and policy frameworks in states like Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, and Telangana [R5b4a7a80, R472c3c1a, R212c0bcb, Re041bd74]. Additionally, states are establishing advanced research facilities, public AI universities, and regional Centers of Excellence to bolster local deep-tech ecosystems and digital skilling [Rc16dddf8, Re78dfed2, R6f55ee54]. These comprehensive developments highlight a nationwide push to integrate high-performance computing, green energy solutions, and enterprise AI capabilities [R3eefbde9, Rb99e617b, R43f4ae2b].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with tech giants, academic institutions, and global corporations to drive artificial intelligence adoption, infrastructure, and skill development [R44971ae6, R472c3c1a, R212c0bcb]. Major infrastructure investments include massive multi-gigawatt data center projects and AI compute hubs in states such as Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Gujarat, and Maharashtra [R5b4a7a80, R1349768b, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1]. Concurrently, states like Bihar, Karnataka, and Assam have entered into targeted collaborations focusing on education, teacher training, voice AI tools, and public service delivery [Reb7bfdb3, R223baf38, R8b7a258f, R604d927c]. Furthermore, specialized agreements in health, agriculture, and governance leverage AI for multilingual services, crime tracking, and healthcare management [Rad868781, R6de84b70, R132d8a77, Rf88612cd].

category:deployment.text: State governments have heavily deployed artificial intelligence across public administration, law enforcement, and citizen services, frequently utilizing WhatsApp chatbots and specialized AI platforms [R127f881c, R68fee1a0, R494484b4]. Key initiatives include deploying AI for exam surveillance and anti-fraud checks in states like Uttar Pradesh, alongside public safety upgrades such as AI copilots for police and crime-tracking tools [R04592b70, Re0c4ff32, Ra6233201]. States are also improving accessibility by integrating multilingual AI and voice portals for localized public service delivery [Rad868781, R3158dd4a, Ra61ec765]. Furthermore, governments are adopting AI solutions in healthcare, agriculture, and disaster management to enhance operational efficiency [R06781a1f, Rf2021859, Ra8c17a13].

category:skilling.text: State governments have heavily prioritized artificial intelligence skilling initiatives targeting both students and teachers across various educational levels. Multiple states, including Punjab, Karnataka, and Tripura, have introduced AI curricula and early tech training in government schools [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R3fff65a8]. Furthermore, large-scale training programs and industry partnerships with entities like Google and Microsoft have been launched to educate millions of youth and thousands of teachers [Reb7bfdb3, Rb312992b, R2889d124]. States such as Uttar Pradesh and Telangana have rolled out extensive missions to skill hundreds of thousands of students in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud computing [Rb312992b, R6843cc3b, Rc6148c8c].

category:events_outreach.text: State governments have actively driven AI adoption and ecosystem growth through regional conclaves, international summits, and stakeholder consultations, such as Uttar Pradesh's Regional AI Impact Conference, Jharkhand's Vision 2050 consultation, and Odisha's participation in the India AI Impact Summit [R84a7e58c, Rf73e4f3d, R4d3bfbb9]. Hackathons, boot camps, and tech expos—including large-scale police surveillance challenges in Gujarat, skill initiatives in Tripura, and the Bengaluru Tech Summit in Karnataka—have been widely deployed to engage youth, students, and developer communities [R3fff65a8, R28ccc09b, Rec3b838b]. Furthermore, specialized workshops focusing on digital governance, multilingual tools like BHASHINI, and sectoral applications in health and agriculture highlight states' efforts to mainstream artificial intelligence across public administration and education [R12d4ab71, Rfe753238, R8e91e0e8].

state:Kerala.text: Kerala has aggressively advanced its AI policy and governance framework by rebranding its IT department to focus on artificial intelligence and future technologies [Ref58a154, R0182578b]. The state launched several major institutional initiatives, including AI Centres of Excellence [Rcaa18758, Rd47ca5ca], a Malayalam AI Mission [R1db5da2a], and a massive investment agreement for an AI data centre [Ra525c46d]. Furthermore, administrative reforms span diverse sectors such as AI-driven public service delivery, disaster management, policing, and education [R8f4114ad, R3391f5dc, R9147ba4b, R70e049dc].

category:governance_body.text: State governments across India have established dedicated governance bodies, ministries, and specialized committees to oversee artificial intelligence policy and deployment. Notable initiatives include Kerala and Tamil Nadu appointing dedicated AI ministers and restructuring their information technology departments to focus on AI and future technologies [R6bbe2d82, Ref58a154, Ref475c84]. Additionally, states like Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Bihar have formed multi-tiered panels, expert committees, and district-level cells to handle ethical AI usage, higher education integration, and land-revenue monitoring [R9b3c768e, R5afedf9c, Ra3ee576b]. Law enforcement and security agencies in states such as Telangana, Haryana, West Bengal, and Jharkhand have similarly constituted specialized AI task forces and tech teams to drive digital policing [Ra1409382, Ra6b5d331, R6e827395, R25c27df1].

overall.text: Indian state governments have widely pursued artificial intelligence initiatives across infrastructure, governance, and education sectors since late 2025. States such as Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Bihar have formally approved comprehensive AI policies or driven major funding commitments and investment MoUs to strengthen local tech ecosystems [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, R44971ae6]. Significant investments are flowing into large-scale data center infrastructure and specialized tech hubs, exemplified by major corporate projects and proposed AI cities in states like Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Telangana [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80]. Simultaneously, states are actively integrating AI into public administration, law enforcement, and judicial frameworks through automated workflows, police copilots, and digital portals [Rd731fc75, R04592b70, Rbd9766bd]. Educational reforms are also prominent, with multiple states introducing AI learning programmes, tech training, and skill development initiatives for students and teachers in government schools [Rf6319e99, R27258895, Rc119f335].

state:Assam.text: Assam is actively advancing artificial intelligence across public governance, infrastructure, and services, marked by the commissioning of its first government-owned GPU cluster and the mapping of hundreds of governance proposals [R936eb0aa, R416e5d33]. The state has integrated AI into critical sectors such as education through teacher training programs and automated attendance systems, healthcare via patient monitoring and plans for robotic surgeries, and environmental management through flood rescue platforms and wildlife protection [R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c, Rdc188dd0, R9c52da90, Ra093ebca]. Partnerships with entities like Google and UNICEF further support capacity building and digital infrastructure development across departments [Red858166, R39b50ddb].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is advancing a comprehensive digital transformation and AI mission, backed by a significant financial investment of Rs 500 crore over five years for skill development, governance, and the digital economy [R7cc53f61, Ra8b92ce6]. Key infrastructure developments include major investments in AI data centers, such as projects by Singapore's Energy Capital Global and an AI Data Center Park in Nava Raipur [R28218dab, Recb4eed4]. The state is also integrating artificial intelligence into education and public services, partnering with Google to train teachers and deploying AI-powered tools for wildlife conservation, road monitoring, and police investigations [R398fad0d, Reb028d74, R8958cba0, R1dec6260, Rd2fe75d0].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana is actively advancing its AI-driven governance and digital infrastructure by integrating artificial intelligence across sectors such as public administration, healthcare, and education [R127f881c, R03b25e4d]. Key initiatives include establishing AI hubs and digital colleges in Gurugram and Panchkula, leveraging AI tools for tuberculosis screening and financial fraud prevention, and modernizing police capabilities to tackle cybercrime [R0a41f591, R770d942f, Re984ab2a]. The state is also reforming education by introducing AI, robotics, and vocational training in schools and ITIs, while partnering with organizations like the World Bank to support its overarching AI mission [Rcd5e27a7, R01ac3f97, R2bca6acc].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across education, governance, healthcare, and environmental management to enhance public service delivery and operational efficiency [Re82f2564]. Significant initiatives include launching AI-powered learning tools like the 'Padhai with AI' app for students, integrating AI skills training for government school teachers, and introducing specialized data science and AI courses in higher education [Rb23a865a, R17bda009, Rc9d96f12]. In the governance and security sectors, the state is deploying AI for document verification, fraud detection within the Himcare health scheme, and narcotics tracking, alongside adopting advanced platforms for disaster risk and ecological restoration [R38e56e62, Rc3a3d3b4, Rc0aeb7f8, R26835c79, Re6fc0429].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its digital and technological framework through the introduction of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 and the Jharkhand AI Vision-2050 roadmap, targeting substantial private investments and job creation [Rb9553546, R927ec078]. Significant actions include signing major investment MoUs, establishing specialized AI centers of excellence, and mandating AI deployment across governance, healthcare, and infrastructure projects [R2269e1a7, R86310780, Rde702427]. The state is also integrating artificial intelligence into education, security monitoring, and wildlife conservation to curb human-wildlife conflicts [Rd25878d1, R96eaad17, R118b938d].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh is rapidly expanding artificial intelligence applications across governance, infrastructure, and public services, backed by major investments and strategic partnerships [R005881fc, R6473839f]. The state has leveraged AI for financial oversight and public procurement monitoring, successfully detecting irregularities and municipal purchase anomalies [R37a735c1, R4c96f220]. Significant technological advancements also include AI-driven surveillance systems for security and crowd management at major religious gatherings like Simhastha 2028, alongside extensive deployments in public healthcare, tourism, and law enforcement [R12d4ab71, R583299ef, R085470af].

state:Manipur.text: The state of Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public sector domains, highlighted by initiatives in digital governance, cybersecurity, and tribal welfare [R8e91e0e8, Rdc31ca32, Re9f95033]. Significant partnerships include an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to expand multilingual AI, as well as collaborations with Microsoft [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. Furthermore, academic and institutional efforts have advanced AI applications through workshops, research colloquiums, and the launch of translation tools like the 'Ishaan' app [R49d826c3, R546f135d, R13590541]. Other notable developments involve exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking and focusing on digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including governance, public health, agriculture, and education, highlighted by initiatives like the Regional AI Impact Conference and partnerships with organizations such as Wadhwani AI [Rd7994ab1, R84a1eeb7, Rf1f88f85]. Significant actions involve drafting a new IT policy focused on AI, proposing a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence, and introducing AI-enabled interactive learning and skill training programs for youth [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R24be49c9, Rc935224b]. Additionally, the state has deployed AI solutions for administrative governance, facial recognition integration, and landslide mapping [R6dd95eb1, Rfbdf90e5].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has undertaken significant policy and governance actions in artificial intelligence, including plans to launch India's first state-level AI policy [Rc68da9b5] and participating in national forums like the AI Impact Summit [R1fa5d707]. The state has forged key partnerships, such as signing an MoU with Google India to build an AI ecosystem [R33168f25] and collaborating with IIT Kharagpur for an innovation hub [R9435f1d2]. In education and healthcare, Tripura has introduced an AI-powered school monitoring system [R20047d48], AI skills initiatives for students [R3fff65a8], robotics labs in schools [R311a6da8], and an agreement with the Centre to supply AI-enabled medical devices like portable X-ray machines [R2235629e, R52c24900]. Furthermore, leadership has advocated for adopting AI-based technology in police traffic management [R8edb04a8] and expanding employment opportunities through targeted AI training programs [Rb70cb3d9].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has systematically integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public service sectors under state initiatives. Key measures include mandating AI education across 45 state universities targeting one lakh youth annually [Rcea6d545], launching AI voice portals and helpline agents for local languages and cyber crime complaints [R3158dd4a, R549f779d], and deploying advanced surveillance for forest monitoring and disaster prediction [R82962675, Rca18ab02]. Additionally, the government has leveraged AI for revenue tax evasion checks, wildlife conflict management, and high-tech security at major events like the Chardham Yatra [Recb1f69d, R994e0e10, R9dac4ef2].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal has actively pursued AI integration across industrial, administrative, and educational sectors, underscored by draft industrial policy approvals focusing on data centres and AI-led growth [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R1ada3e48]. Significant governance actions include the establishment of police AI cells, investigative apps like Samarth, and AI-powered helplines to address cybercrime and improve public accountability [R6e827395, R904a08ab, R08e415eb]. Furthermore, the state has promoted skill development through partnerships with Oracle to train thousands of students, while advancing infrastructure through urban service explorations and school modernisation programs [Rebcdd9ec, Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1].

state:Rajasthan.text: The state government of Rajasthan has actively integrated artificial intelligence into public administration, agriculture, healthcare, and security, anchored by the approval of the AI-ML Policy 2026 [R6a6bee70, Re0df1048]. Major initiatives include leveraging Wadhwani AI partnerships and digital platforms for crop monitoring and agricultural services [R6de84b70, R1603c33d], deploying AI-driven tools for public grievance redressal and health tracking [Rcaf01e51, R0d19612d], and expanding surveillance through AI-powered cameras, facial recognition, and traffic management systems [Rd7e6b721, R0af96cb6, R1531f46e]. Additionally, the state has launched educational and skill-building measures, such as introducing AI into school syllabi and offering foundational AI training courses to citizens [Rf789607f, R2c694631].

state:Nagaland.text: Nagaland's AI policy activity centers on infrastructure development, governance enhancement, and sectoral modernization through targeted initiatives. Significant actions include the inauguration of an AI Centre of Excellence for Skilling by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and the unveiling of the Eliona AI Supercomputer for disaster preparedness [R6f55ee54, Ra8c17a13]. Additionally, the state has advanced digital governance and public service delivery by launching an AI-powered Unified Digital Agriculture Ecosystem and a WhatsApp chatbot for skill development services [R3a286812, R1ee21379]. Educational and capacity-building efforts are further supported by faculty development workshops, AI implementation seminars in governance, and plans for school education reforms [Ree819f7b, R7b191484, R8a5917e4].
